Package com.elotouch.elopay.library

Class ZBCRManager

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.elotouch.elopay.library.ZBCRManager
  • public final class ZBCRManager
extends java.lang.Object
    High level manager used to use Zebra Barcode Reader This class provides apis to open Zebra BCR and receive the scan results

      • enableOutputMode

        public void enableOutputMode​(@NonNull
                             java.lang.String name,
                             int output,
                             boolean enabled)
        Enable/Disable a specified output mode for a scan profile.
        Parameters:
        name - The name of the scan profile.
        output - The output mode to be enabled or disabled. This is represented as a bit flag:
        • 01: OUTPUT_MODE_KEYBOARD
        • 10: OUTPUT_MODE_INTENT
        • 11: Both OUTPUT_MODE_KEYBOARD and OUTPUT_MODE_INTENT
        enabled - The boolean state of the output mode.


        For example, to enable the INTENT output mode, call: 

        enableOutputMode("ScanProfileName", ScanProfile.OUTPUT_MODE_INTENT, true);
        Then, if you want only the INTENT mode enabled, you should disable the KEYBOARD output mode by calling: 
        enableOutputMode("ScanProfileName", ScanProfile.OUTPUT_MODE_KEYBOARD, false);

        If both output modes are set to true, both INTENT and KEYBOARD modes will be active at the same time.
